messages:
maria: Heads-up — EU canary for payments chart (2.3.0 -> 2.4.0) is blocked. deploy-bot flagged health failures and an image tag mismatch between regions. Holding canary. @deploy-bot can you paste the failure log?

deploy-bot: Canary blocked: preflight health-check failed on payments in eu-west-1 — readiness probe timed out 5/5. Observed imageTag mismatch: us-west-2 -> v2.4.0, eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0 (values override). No automatic rollback executed.

simon: Wait — how did eu-west-1 get v2.3.0 while the chart bumped to 2.4.0? values-sync job should have applied the new values. Could be a manual override or staging copy leak.

olivia: Confession: I pushed a manual override to eu/values/payments.yaml last night to pin to the proven image for holiday traffic. I planned to remove it after validation but forgot. That explains the mismatch. Sorry.

maria: Ok — decision time. Options: 1) pin EU to chart 2.3.x and continue rollout elsewhere, 2) revert override now and force-sync (will cause restarts), or 3) abort global rollout and rollback. We have ~25m left in the change window. Thoughts?

simon: Prefer minimal blast radius. Option 1: annotate/pin eu-west-1 to 2.3.1 so we don't touch live instances. Continue the US rollout. Schedule a follow-up canary for EU once override is removed. Also add a line to release notes explaining regional pin.

olivia: I can open the revert PR now, but reverting will trigger pod restarts in EU which might not be safe during the window. If we pin instead we can do the revert in the next window.

dev-bot: /rollout annotate payments eu-west-1 release.pin=2.3.1 — command accepted, queued by simon.

deploy-bot: Annotated payments @ eu-west-1: release.pin=2.3.1 applied. Region pinned; canary skipped in eu-west-1. Global canary continues in other regions.

maria: Thanks. Simon, please add a short release note and a rollback playbook entry for pin removal. Olivia, open the revert PR and mark it do-not-promote until we've verified post-canary. I'll keep an eye on latency and error budgets for US.

simon: Adding release note now: '- Regional pin: eu-west-1 retained on payments chart v2.3.1 due to manual values override; follow-up canary scheduled 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC. See playbook: /playbooks/helm-pin-rollback.md'

olivia: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/4321 — reversion of eu/values/payments.yaml. Marked WIP until after window.

maria: Confirming current state — EU pinned, US rollout at 30% canary. I'll post a short summary in release-notes once we close the window. Monitoring dashboards up.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic in us-west-2: 30% -> health checks passing (99.7% ready) at 2m. No service-errors observed.

maria: Nice. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
